cohort: 14 women who had undergone either liver (n=5) or renal (n=9) transplantation and subsequently underwent cesarean section between January 1997 and January 2017.
finding: Both general and regional anesthesia can be safely used during cesarean delivery in liver and renal transplant recipients without increased risk to mother or fetus, although prematurity and low birth weight were observed, likely due to immunosuppressant medications.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight reported (not specified if this includes only low birth weight infants)
